  {"step":2,"file":"src/lib/openjp2/j2k.c","function":"opj_j2k_read_sot","line":4460,"var":"p_header_data","code":"opj_j2k_get_sot_values(..., &(p_j2k->m_current_tile_number), &l_tot_len, &l_current_part, &l_num_parts, ...)","note":"The decoder parses the SOT marker and extracts the current tile-part number and declared tile-part count from the input stream."},

  {"step":4,"file":"src/lib/openjp2/j2k.c","function":"opj_j2k_read_sot","line":4680,"var":"p_j2k->cstr_index->tile_index[p_j2k->m_current_tile_number].tp_index","code":"tp_index = (opj_tp_index_t*)opj_calloc(l_num_parts, sizeof(opj_tp_index_t));","note":"The tile-part index array is allocated using the declared count, so later tile-part numbers beyond this bound are not represented."},
  {"step":5,"file":"src/lib/openjp2/j2k.c","function":"opj_j2k_read_sot","line":4725,"var":"p_j2k->cstr_index->tile_index[p_j2k->m_current_tile_number].tp_index[l_current_part]","code":"new_tp_index = (opj_tp_index_t *) opj_realloc(..., p_j2k->cstr_index->tile_index[p_j2k->m_current_tile_number].current_nb_tps * sizeof(opj_tp_index_t));","note":"If the current tile-part number exceeds the allocated count, the code updates the tile-part index using that out-of-bounds number, causing a heap buffer overflow."}
